title: Phytip Protein A, ProPlus, ProPlus LX Columns - Protein Purification
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Set run parameters
steps.instruction: Specify the Number of Samples (1‑96) for this run and choose the P300 Multi‑Channel Mount (left or right) on the OT‑2.

steps.title: Pick up PhyTip columns
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2, pick up the PhyTip® Protein A, ProPlus or ProPlus LX columns located in slot 3.

steps.title: Equilibrate resin with buffer
steps.instruction: Pass equilibration buffer from slot 9 over the resin bed for 4 cycles; in each cycle aspirate and dispense 180 µL at 240 µL/min.

steps.title: Capture sample on resin
steps.instruction: Pass the sample from slot 2 over the resin bed for 8 cycles; in each cycle aspirate and dispense 180 µL at 240 µL/min.

steps.title: Wash resin with buffer 1
steps.instruction: Pass wash buffer 1 from slot 5 over the resin bed for 2 cycles; in each cycle aspirate and dispense 180 µL at 480 µL/min.

steps.title: Wash resin with buffer 2
steps.instruction: Pass wash buffer 2 from slot 7 over the resin bed for 2 cycles.

steps.title: Elute resin with elution buffer
steps.instruction: Pass elution buffer from slot 11 over the resin bed for 4 cycles; in each cycle aspirate and dispense 130 µL at 240 µL/min.
